title: SWE2: SubWord Enriched and Significant Word Emphasized Framework for Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (accuracy and F1 score) of a binary text classification framework (SWE2) in detecting human-generated hate speech (including racism and sexism from the Waseem dataset) in social media text, specifically measuring the model's robustness against character-level adversarial attacks such as deliberate misspellings and typos.
